Subject: Capacity review: request to add GPUs ahead of renewal

Hi Priya,

Quick note from our ops team — Q1 usage spiked from our models after the March experiment and we saw sustained 18–22% higher peak utilization across our Dedicated pool. We're scheduled to renew in August but need to understand options for adding capacity earlier.

Attached is our Q1 usage export (usage_report_Q1.csv). Key ask: can we add capacity on a short runway (30–60 days) and then convert to reserved after renewal, or do you recommend a direct reserved top-up now? Our constraints: SOC2 controls, prefer minimal drift to our committed tranche, and we'd like predictable latency for inference SLAs (99th percentile < 180ms).

Can we get a short assessment and options by EOD Friday? Happy to hop on a 30m call.

Thanks,

Ava — thanks for the data and the clear ask.

Short answer: yes, we can add capacity in a short runway and offer a path to convert to reserved (Dedicated) before or at renewal. Options depend on the shape of your traffic (burst vs sustained) and whether you prefer a hard commit or phased conversion. I looped in Karthik (account lead) and Monica (solutions) to scope a recommended plan.

Proposed next steps:
- Karthik/Monica: quick review of the attached CSV and an internal sizing note; recommend 3–6 additional A100-equivalent GPUs in a phased rollout (start with 4 on burst-equipped capacity for 30d, re-evaluate).
- If Lumina prefers dedicated preserves, we can prepare an SOW draft and a staged billing amendment: 30d burst credits -> convert to reserved with a 6mo pro-rated commit.
- Schedule a 30m call Thu 10am PT or Thu 3pm PT to align.

Ava — would Thu 10am PT work?

Cheers,

Folks — forwarding Lumina's CSV and ask. High level notes after a quick pass:

- Observed: 30-day rolling peak token throughput up ~21% vs prior quarter; median seq length increased from 384 -> 510. KV cache hit rate dropped ~6% (looks like more long-context reranking jobs).
- Current Dedicated tranche: 48 A100-eq GPUs (effective throughput ~138k tokens/s burst-capable). Average sustained utilization now ~72%, 95th-percentile bursts > 92%.

Recommendation (phased):
1) Immediate short-run: allocate 4 additional A100-eq on burst-enabled pool for 30 days to blunt 95th percentile latency spikes. This uses burst credits and keeps billing flexible.
2) If usage stays above 68% sustained after 30d, convert 4 GPUs to reserved capacity with a 6–12 month pro-rata commit (SOW attached). This keeps unit costs predictable and preserves isolation.
3) Operational mitigations: enable prefix KV caching for the top 3 prompts (Monica to advise), tighten batch size cap for low-latency endpoints, and tune autoscale cooldown to 45s.

SOW_draft_v2.pdf attached for legal/finance routing — it includes the pro-rata terms and a conversion window.

Questions for you both: any constraints on lead time for reserved allocation (we typically need 10 business days to guarantee dedicated slots for the A100-equivalent profile), and can we lean on a 30% discount window for mid-term top-ups (commercial check)?

- Priya

Recap of situation:
- Q1 usage shows sustained uplift; current fleet 48 A100-eq with 72% sustained utilization and 95th-percentile bursts > 92%.
- Immediate risk: latency SLOs at peak; short runway strategy preferred to avoid SLA degradation.

Agreed path forward:
1) Short-run allocation: Redwood will provision 4 A100-equivalent GPUs in your burst-capable pool starting Mon Jun 15 for a 30-day evaluation. This is provisioned as "burst top-up" and billed as usage with transparent token-level breakdown.
2) Measurement window: we will collect metrics (token throughput, p95 latency, KV cache hit) and review on Jul 15. If sustained utilization > 68% in that window, Lumina may convert the 4 GPUs to reserved Dedicated capacity with a 6-month pro-rated commit.
3) Commercials & SOW: SOW draft (link below) outlines conversion pricing and pro-rata terms. Karthik will confirm discount eligibility; Monica will own implementation steps (cache tuning, batch caps).
4) Operational: Monica will push a short-run tuning plan (prefix caching + batch limits) by Mon Jun 14. Priya to send DocuSign link for conversion-ready SOW.

Links and attachments:
- SOW draft: https://redwood.company/sow/DL-2026-0783
